faqs.a: An SVG blob is an irregular rounded shape drawn with a vector path. Designers use them as soft decorative backgrounds behind text, portraits and icons because they feel friendly and modern.

The tool places a chosen number of points around a circle and pulls each one toward or away from the center by a random amount. It then connects the points with smooth quadratic curves, producing the wavy organic outline.

keyFacts: A blob is an organic, irregular rounded shape defined by a single SVG path element.
This generator builds the path from points arranged around a circle with randomized radii.
A seeded random number generator (mulberry32) decides the shape, so every shuffle is unique.
Quadratic Bézier curves through the midpoints of point pairs create the smooth wavy edge.
The output is a standard SVG file that works in every modern browser and design tool.
Fill color, size, rotation and edge smoothness are all adjustable before download.

svg-blob-generator.workedExample:
You set points = 8, irregularity = 30% and canvas size = 400 px.

Base radius R = 400 × 0.4 = 160 px.
Each point radius = 160 × (1 ± 0.30), so every radius falls between 160 × 0.70 = 112 px and 160 × 1.30 = 208 px.
Angles are 360 ÷ 8 = 45° apart. The generator joins the eight points with quadratic curves through their midpoints, producing a smooth closed path that fills roughly the middle 55% of the canvas.
